versions.subject: Update proc_creation_macos_jxa_in-memory_execution.yml
versions.detection:
selection1:
    CommandLine|contains: 
    - 'osascript'
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains|all: 
    - '-l'
    - 'JavaScript'
selection3:
    CommandLine|contains: '.js'
selection4:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
    - '-e'
    - 'eval'
    - 'NSData.dataWithContentsOfURL'
condition: selection1 and (selection2 or selection3) and selection4
versions.spl: CommandLine="*osascript*" (CommandLine="*-l*" CommandLine="*JavaScript*") OR CommandLine="*.js*" CommandLine="*-e*" CommandLine="*eval*" CommandLine="*NSData.dataWithContentsOfURL*"
